translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the fourth month, 姚棻 was relieved due to illness. 田鳳儀福建: Governor. On the gengwu day of the seventh month, was relieved due to mourning. 費淳 served as replacement. 陳奉茲護. On the jiashen day of the ninth month, 費淳 was transferred. 汪志伊 was appointed to fill the vacancy.

On the jiashen day of the ninth month, 費淳 was transferred. 汪志伊 was appointed to fill the vacancy.

translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the first month he returned and served in an acting capacity; on the dingsi day of the fourth month he was appointed Governor of Jiangxi.

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, 崇恩 came to the capital. 張灃中山東: Governor. 陳孚恩 served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, 崇恩 came to the capital. 張灃中山東: Governor. 陳孚恩 served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 林則徐三月乙未調。楊以增陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the third month, 林則徐 was transferred. 楊以增陝西: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the third month, 林則徐 was transferred. 楊以增陝西: Governor.

sentences.zh: 徐廣縉十二月甲戌調。葉名琛護廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month, 徐廣縉 was transferred. 葉名琛護廣東: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month, 徐廣縉 was transferred. 葉名琛護廣東: Governor.
The twenty-eighth year of the Daoguang reign (wushen).

sentences.zh: 張灃中六月癸卯卒。徐澤醇山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the sixth month, 張灃中 died. 徐澤醇山東: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the sixth month, 張灃中 died. 徐澤醇山東: Governor.

sentences.zh: 鄂順安八月丁巳革。潘鐸河南巡撫。鍾祥署。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the eighth month, 鄂順安 was dismissed. 潘鐸河南: Governor. 鍾祥 served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the eighth month, 鄂順安 was dismissed. 潘鐸河南: Governor. 鍾祥 served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 楊以增九月甲戌遷。陳士枚陝西巡撫。十二月丙寅革。恆春署。張祥河代。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the ninth month, 楊以增 was transferred. 陳士枚陝西: Governor. On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, was dismissed. 恆春 served in an acting capacity. 張祥河 served as replacement.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the ninth month, 楊以增 was transferred. 陳士枚陝西: Governor. On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, was dismissed. 恆春 served in an acting capacity. 張祥河 served as replacement.

sentences.zh: 梁寶常六月丙辰憂。傅繩勛浙江巡撫。劉堯海署。庚午吳文鎔代。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the sixth month, 梁寶常 went into mourning. 傅繩勛浙江: Governor. 劉堯海 served in an acting capacity. On the gengwu day, 吳文鎔 served as replacement.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the sixth month, 梁寶常 went into mourning. 傅繩勛浙江: Governor. 劉堯海 served in an acting capacity. On the gengwu day, 吳文鎔 served as replacement.

sentences.zh: 吳文鎔六月庚午調。傅繩勛江西巡撫。費開綬署。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the sixth month, 吳文鎔 was transferred. 傅繩勛江西: Governor. 費開綬 served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the sixth month, 吳文鎔 was transferred. 傅繩勛江西: Governor. 費開綬 served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 喬用遷九月癸巳覲。羅繞典署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the ninth month, 喬用遷 came to court. 羅繞典 served in an acting capacity as Governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the ninth month, 喬用遷 came to court. 羅繞典 served in an acting capacity as Governor of Guizhou.
The twenty-ninth year of the Daoguang reign (jiyou).

sentences.zh: 陸建瀛四月壬寅遷。傅繩勛江蘇巡撫。程煥署。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the fourth month, 陸建瀛 was transferred. 傅繩勛江蘇: Governor. 程煥 served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fourth month, 陸建瀛 was transferred. 傅繩勛江蘇: Governor. 程煥 served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 徐澤醇九月己酉遷。陳慶偕山東巡撫。劉源灝署。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, 徐澤醇 was transferred. 陳慶偕山東: Governor. 劉源灝 served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, 徐澤醇 was transferred. 陳慶偕山東: Governor. 劉源灝 served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 王兆琛五月己未革逮。季芝昌山西巡撫。兆那蘇圖署。八月丙戌季芝昌遷。龔裕代。十一月甲辰調湖北。兆那蘇圖任。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the fifth month, 王兆琛 was dismissed and arrested. 季芝昌山西: Governor. 兆那蘇圖 served in an acting capacity. On the bingxu day of the eighth month, 季芝昌 was transferred. 龔裕 served as replacement. On the jiachen day of the eleventh month, 調湖北. 兆那蘇圖任.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fifth month, 王兆琛 was dismissed and arrested. 季芝昌山西: Governor. 兆那蘇圖 served in an acting capacity. On the bingxu day of the eighth month, 季芝昌 was transferred. 龔裕 served as replacement. On the jiachen day of the eleventh month, 調湖北. 兆那蘇圖任.

sentences.zh: 傅繩勛四月壬寅調。費開綬江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the fourth month, 傅繩勛 was transferred. 費開綬江西: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fourth month, 傅繩勛 was transferred. 費開綬江西: Governor.

sentences.zh: 趙炳言閏四月癸酉調。羅繞典湖北巡撫。十一月甲辰憂。龔裕代。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the intercalary fourth month, 趙炳言 was transferred. 羅繞典湖北: Governor. On the jiachen day of the eleventh month, went into mourning. 龔裕 served as replacement.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the intercalary fourth month, 趙炳言 was transferred. 羅繞典湖北: Governor. On the jiachen day of the eleventh month, went into mourning. 龔裕 served as replacement.

sentences.zh: 陸費瑔閏四月癸酉憂。趙炳言湖南巡撫。七月戊戌遷。馮德馨代。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the intercalary fourth month, 陸費瑔 went into mourning. 趙炳言湖南: Governor. On the wuxu day of the seventh month, was transferred. 馮德馨 served as replacement.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the intercalary fourth month, 陸費瑔 went into mourning. 趙炳言湖南: Governor. On the wuxu day of the seventh month, was transferred. 馮德馨 served as replacement.

sentences.zh: 程矞采七月己未遷。張日晸雲南巡撫。程矞采兼署。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the seventh month, 程矞采 was transferred. 張日晸雲南: Governor. 程矞采 concurrently served in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the seventh month, 程矞采 was transferred. 張日晸雲南: Governor. 程矞采 concurrently served in an acting capacity.
The thirtieth year of the Daoguang reign (gengxu).

sentences.zh: 吳文鎔十一月丙午遷。常大淳浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, 吳文鎔 was transferred. 常大淳浙江: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, 吳文鎔 was transferred. 常大淳浙江: Governor.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午開缺。江西巡撫。暫署。十二月辛未革。代。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renwu, post declared vacant. Jiangxi Provincial Governor. Temporarily acting. Twelfth month, day xinwei, dismissed. Replaced.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eighth month the post of Governor of Jiangxi was declared vacant and he temporarily acted in it; on the xinwei day of the twelfth month he was dismissed and replaced.

sentences.zh: 馮德馨二月辛巳來京。萬貢珍署。三月丙寅駱秉章湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the second month, 馮德馨 came to the capital. 萬貢珍 served in an acting capacity. On the bingyin day of the third month, 駱秉章湖南: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month, 馮德馨 came to the capital. 萬貢珍 served in an acting capacity. On the bingyin day of the third month, 駱秉章湖南: Governor.

sentences.zh: 十月壬午革。暫署。十一月庚子卒。署廣西巡撫。暫署。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renwu, dismissed. Temporarily acting. Eleventh month, day gengzi, died in office. Acting Guangxi Provincial Governor. Temporarily acting.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the tenth month he was dismissed and temporarily acted in the post; on the gengzi day of the eleventh month he died in office while serving as acting Governor of Guangxi, with another officer temporarily acting in turn.

sentences.zh: 張日晸八月癸亥卒。張亮基雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month, 張日晸 died. 張亮基雲南: Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month, 張日晸 died. 張亮基雲南: Governor.
